=== the 68000 integer instructions a ColdFire kept
 movel %d0,%d1
 movel #0x12345678,%a0@
 moveb %a1@+,%a2@-
 addl %d0,%a1@(8)
 subl %a0,%d3
 lea %a0@(8,%d1:l:4),%a2
 moveml %d0-%d3/%a2,%sp@
 moveml %sp@,%d0-%d3/%a2
 tstl %a0@
 cmpl %d1,%d2
 mulsl %d0,%d1
 divuw %d2,%d3
 swap %d4
 extbl %d5
 negl %d6
 seq %d7
=== jra and jbsr to an address register
 jra %a0@
 jbsr %a1@(4)
=== a ColdFire ISA_B relaxes branches to 32 bits
top: nop
 jbeq far
 jra far
 jbsr far
 .space 40000
far: rts
